description: This Java class defines a custom Android View called MyDrawView that allows users to draw on the screen with touch input; it manages a bitmap for drawing, handles touch events to create paths, and provides a method to clear the drawing.

classes.name: MyDrawView
classes.description: Custom Android View enabling drawing with touch input, managing off-screen bitmap and paths.

methods.name: MyDrawView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes paint objects and path for drawing.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Creates or updates the bitmap and canvas when view size changes.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the bitmap and current path onto the canvas.

methods.name: touch_start
methods.description: Begins a new path at the specified touch point.

methods.name: touch_move
methods.description: Adds a quadratic Bezier segment to the path following the touch movement.

methods.name: touch_up
methods.description: Completes the current path and commits it to the canvas.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events to initiate, update, or finalize drawing paths.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the drawing by erasing the bitmap and repainting.
